definitions.throughput_denominator: raw.elapsed_s, including arrival gaps, waiting, and final drain
definitions.joint_slo: finished AND TTFT <= ttft_s AND maximum observed generation gap <= gap_s AND completion-arrival <= completion_s; all recorded requests are in the denominator
definitions.qualified_tokens: All output tokens of requests meeting every joint SLO condition
definitions.generation_gap: Differences between adjacent observed token_times_s within a request; excludes TTFT; a single observed output token has gap zero; NOT a claim of true token ITL
definitions.percentiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; headline mean/p95/max are null if any request is unobserved; observed-only diagnostics remain in JSON
definitions.makespan: Latest completion minus earliest arrival; null unless all requests completed
definitions.workload_completeness: All raw.json requests must finish; omitted arrivals are detectable only when protocol.request_count is supplied
definitions.prefill_cap: Recorded budget field; averages distinguish mixed, prefill, and all steps
definitions.fixed_lengths: Each request must emit max_tokens outputs; cumulative per-request prefill must equal prompt_tokens and decode must equal output_tokens-1; step totals must conserve these amounts
definitions.warmup: is_warmup is true when any raw.json parent path segment starts with warm, case insensitive; --exclude-warmup removes these runs before comparison
